payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan checking for any adjacent a[i] >= a[i-1]; if found, array is not strictly decreasing, so answer YES; else NO.
payload.rationale: The solution exploits the property that only strictly decreasing arrays require n*(n-1)/2 swaps (which exceeds limit). It checks this in O(n) without sorting. Among the candidate subtypes, sorting_custom_key is the closest by problem domain despite not using a custom sort.
